description: Queues a judging of which photo should lead and whether each crop cuts a subject, and returns the run id at once. The answers come from stills_judge_get once the run is done (the change stream tells you; do not poll). Nothing in the layout changes: what it proposes stays a proposal (applied false) until a labeled set of 50 groups has passed.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_judge
title: Judge a stills layout
